user_story: As a guest, I want to retrieve a booking by its ID so that I can see its details.

positive.title: Retrieve booking details using a valid booking ID
steps: Navigate to the booking retrieval page.
Enter a valid booking ID in the input field.
positive.expected_result: The system displays the booking details corresponding to the provided booking ID.

negative.title: Attempt to retrieve booking details using an invalid booking ID
steps: Navigate to the booking retrieval page.
Enter an invalid booking ID in the input field.
negative.expected_result: The system displays an error message stating that the booking ID is not found or invalid.

edge.title: Attempt to retrieve booking details using an empty booking ID
steps: Navigate to the booking retrieval page.
Leave the booking ID input field empty.
edge.expected_result: The system displays an error message indicating that the booking ID cannot be empty.
